messages:
mike_ops: Heads-up — vendor flagged a customs reclassification on the EU inbound container (HScode changed). Holding ~60 GPUs (mixed H100/H200). Vendor asking if we want to airpatch priority units or wait for clearance. Need decision fast, this will impact Dedicated pool for EU this week.

jurgen_vendor: Sorry for the noise — customs re-rated 15 SKUs under `8542.31` vs initial declaration, local tax authority asked for additional duty docs. Current ETA for release if we contest is ~7–10 business days.

jurgen_vendor: Option A: contest + paperwork (7–10d) at vendor cost to expedite review, shipping stays sea — no additional freight cost but time. Option B: airpatch 18 units now (2–3d) for +€11k, vendor can split AWB and include temporary loaner labeling. Option C: full air (60 units) but cost is ~+€35k and needs urgent PO amendment.

lina_procure: Do we have enough loaners in US to cover EU Dedicated? I can check pool counts, but cross-continental sends take ~48h at best.

ops-bot: ALERT: projected EU Dedicated spare headroom falls to 0 on 2024-09-26 if no replacements. Impact: canary and low-priority jobs throttled.

anna_sre: If we lose 60 units for 7–10d, our autoscaler will start shedding non-prod batch jobs. Latency SLO for inference routes alpha/eu-gen will degrade. Recommend moving canaries to US region + enable fallback model variant to reduce tokens.

lina_procure: Quick inventory: US loaner pool = 24 H100 equiv, 10 pending in transit. Net available for immediate cross-ship = 12. Not enough to cover all 60 but can cover critical lanes.

mike_ops: Proposal: take Option B for 18 priority units airpatch (cover production lanes), request vendor to issue credit for expedited freight or absorb insurance/duties if contest fails. Meanwhile contest remaining container to try to recover 42 units.

jurgen_vendor: We can do that. For Option B we need a signed amendment for +€11k and a serial list for the 18 units to prep AWBs. If you want vendor to absorb duties on contest failure, that's a separate claim — we can negotiate a credit but need approval from logistics team.

sam_legal: Before we sign amendment, I'll need the contract addendum template. We should request written commitment on credit/waiver language: specifically "vendor indemnifies taxes/duties resulting from incorrect HS classification on this shipment" or defined credit cap. I can draft a one-pg amendment.

mike_ops: Lina — please export serial list for the 18 units we prioritize and drop into the procurement thread. Use `ship-team` tag for AWB creation. Sam — will you draft amendment? Target: get amendment signed within 24h.

lina_procure: Uploading serials now to Confluence: https://redwood.internal/confluence/proc/serials-eu-hs-check (folder "EU-priority-18"). AWB contact: <logistics@vendor.com>.

jurgen_vendor: Received serials. We'll provision AWBs once amendment signed and payment/PO amendment in place. Suggest using DHL Express (faster) or KLM airbridge. I can push DHL rate + paperwork.

anna_sre: Ops note — please add routing policy to send critical inference traffic to US pool during the split. I'll open a short-lived routing rule and annotate the runbook. Also set reduce_batch_size for prod-gen routes to limit queue growth.

ops-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: #1 lina_procure upload serials (done). #2 sam_legal draft amendment. #3 mike_ops approve PO amendment. #4 anna_sre apply routing fallback.

sam_legal: Draft ready, small ask: limit vendor indemnity to shipments with documented mis-declaration; request original paperwork showing declared HS code. Also include a 30-day window for credit claims. I'll post doc in /legal/changes.

mike_ops: I'm approving PO amendment for +€11k to release 18 units as long as we get the written indemnity/credit language. Lina, please confirm invoice/PO update and we can sign.

lina_procure: PO updated (PO# 4567-A), invoice sent to finance for expedited payment. I flagged finance for immediate processing.

jurgen_vendor: AWBs created: AWB# DHL12345678..90 (batch for 18). ETA EU hub: 48–72h. We'll mark as "redwood loaner" on labels and include temporary RMA tags.

anna_sre: Once air units arrive, ops should stage them immediately into Dedicated EU pool and mark as "loaner — temp" in inventory. I'll coordinate a brief maintenance window for node swap.

mike_ops: Final decision thread summary: Airpatch 18 units (Option B) approved; vendor to accept credit/indemnity terms (TBD per Sam); contest remaining container (7–10d) at vendor assistance; route critical traffic to US loaners; action owners assigned.

jurgen_vendor: Noted. Starting AWB booking and paperwork submission. We'll follow up with proof of shipment and invoice lines for expedited freight.

ops-bot: THREAD CLOSED (by mike_ops) — agreed plan in place.
